ui.chat.attachments.pending_caption.role: caption under the composer chip row
ui.chat.attachments.pending_caption.note: The chips are staged, not sent. States the composer row is pending so a reader cannot mistake it for a sent file card.

ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.role: type and size line on a file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.tone: machine facts, middle dot separator, no sentence
ui.chat.attachments.file_meta.note: Preserve the separator and both placeholders. type is a short uppercase extension (PDF, MD); size is a formatted byte count.

ui.chat.attachments.file_missing.role: existence verdict on a sent file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_missing.note: Shown when the origin path no longer exists on this machine. The recovery line follows it; this verdict must read as a fact about the original file, not as an error about the message.

ui.chat.attachments.file_retained.role: retained-copy line under the missing verdict
ui.chat.attachments.file_retained.note: Diagnostic detail shown in the recovery line's tooltip, not the default sentence (design round 1, D2). digest is the attachment store content address; do not translate or shorten the placeholder.

ui.chat.attachments.file_unnamed.role: filename fallback on a file card
ui.chat.attachments.file_unnamed.note: Only when a document block carried no filename.

ui.chat.attachments.copy_path.role: accessible name of the copy control beside a sent file path
ui.chat.attachments.copy_path.note: Copies the full absolute path, not the truncated line shown on screen.

ui.chat.attachments.path_copied.role: confirmation for the path copy control
ui.chat.attachments.path_copied.note: Announced politely for two seconds after a successful copy; not a toast.

ui.chat.attachments.file_missing_recover.role: line under the missing verdict when the row has NO store path
ui.chat.attachments.file_missing_recover.note: The origin file is gone. Do not claim a saved copy here: without a store path the card cannot name or copy one (design round 2, D2).

ui.chat.attachments.file_type_unknown.role: type fallback on a file card with no readable extension or MIME subtype
ui.chat.attachments.file_type_unknown.note: Only when neither the filename nor the MIME type names a type.

ui.chat.attachments.copy_saved_path.role: accessible name of the copy control in the missing state
ui.chat.attachments.copy_saved_path.note: Copies the STORE path of the retained copy, not the origin path that no longer exists. Shown only when the row carries a store path.

ui.chat.attachments.saved_path_copied.role: confirmation for the saved-copy copy control
ui.chat.attachments.saved_path_copied.note: Announced politely for two seconds after a successful copy of the retained copy's store path.

ui.chat.attachments.saved_copy_label.role: label on the saved-copy row of a missing file card
ui.chat.attachments.saved_copy_label.note: Introduces the attachment store path of the retained copy, which follows on the same row beside a copy control.

ui.chat.attachments.file_and_copy_missin.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve placeholders exactly.
ui.chat.attachments.file_and_copy_missin.note: Under 'Moved or deleted' on a sent file card: neither the original file nor the app's retained copy exists any more.

ui.chat.attachments.open.note: Opens an attachment this app cannot preview.

ui.chat.attachments.playback_rate_option.note: The multiplier sign stays beside the number in every language; do not spell the word 'times'.

ui.chat.attachments.open_named.role: Accessible name of a picture tile that opens the picture
ui.chat.attachments.open_named.note: Imperative plus the file's display name.

placeholders.name: File display name; do not translate.

ui.chat.attachments.expand_aria.role: Accessible name of a pasted or attached picture's expand control
ui.chat.attachments.expand_aria.note: Imperative plus the file's display name.

placeholders.name: File display name; do not translate.

ui.chat.attachments.expand_title.role: Tooltip of a pasted or attached picture's expand control

placeholders.name: File display name; do not translate.

ui.chat.attachments.open_title.role: Tooltip of a file or video attachment's open control

placeholders.name: File display name; do not translate.

ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable.role: Tooltip of an attachment card the app cannot show

placeholders.name: File display name; do not translate.

ui.chat.attachments.owner_unreachable.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.chat.attachments.owner_unreachable.note: Follows the attachment's file name in a receipt, e.g. 'chart.png couldn't be fetched…'. Lower-case start because it continues the name.

ui.chat.attachments.retry_fetch.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.chat.attachments.retry_fetch.note: Retries fetching an image, video or sound from the device that holds it.

ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_detail.role: warning line on an attachment card for a media file (audio or video) that could not be shown
ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_detail.tone: plain statement, lowercase parenthetical, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_detail.length: One sentence with a short parenthetical; truncates with an ellipsis on a narrow card.
ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_detail.note: The file name opens the sentence, so a language that cannot start with a name may reorder it. The parenthetical lists the three likely causes: the file was not fully written, was deleted, or was moved.

placeholders.name: the attachment's file name (last path segment), never translated

ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_too_lar.role: warning line on an attachment card for a file that is over the preview size cap, where the file itself is fine
ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_too_lar.length: One short sentence; truncates with an ellipsis on a narrow card.
ui.chat.attachments.not_viewable_too_lar.note: Says WHY there is no preview: the file is not broken, it is too big to show, and the card offers the operating system instead. Distinct from `not_viewable_detail`, whose three guessed causes (incomplete, deleted, moved) would be false here. The file name opens the sentence, so a language that cannot start with a name may reorder it.

placeholders.name: the attachment's file name (last path segment), never translated

ui.chat.attachments.broken_moved.role: whole-sentence receipt in place of an attachment (picture or file) the app could not read from disk
ui.chat.attachments.broken_moved.tone: plain statement, sentence case, full stops
ui.chat.attachments.broken_moved.length: One sentence; it is the card's whole text, the tooltip and the accessible name, and truncates with an ellipsis on a narrow card.
ui.chat.attachments.broken_moved.note: Says what happened, what it probably means, and nothing the app cannot know. The three causes are guesses about a file path, so keep 'may have been'. The name opens the sentence; a language that cannot start with a name may reorder it. The same message is the visible text, the tooltip and the accessible name.

placeholders.name: the attachment's file name, shown verbatim and never translated; the code wraps it in a directional isolate

ui.chat.attachments.broken_unavailable.role: whole-sentence receipt in place of a picture whose stored copy did not arrive
ui.chat.attachments.broken_unavailable.tone: plain statement, sentence case, full stops
ui.chat.attachments.broken_unavailable.length: One sentence; it is the card's whole text, the tooltip and the accessible name, and truncates with an ellipsis on a narrow card.
ui.chat.attachments.broken_unavailable.note: States the fact (the read failed) and stops; it deliberately names no cause, because 'never stored' and 'pruned' cannot be told apart. 'this reader' is this app on this device. The name opens the sentence; a language that cannot start with a name may reorder it. Same message for the visible text, tooltip and accessible name.

placeholders.name: the attachment's file name, shown verbatim and never translated; the code wraps it in a directional isolate

ui.chat.attachments.broken_media_unavail.role: whole-sentence receipt in place of a video or audio clip whose stored copy did not arrive or could not be decoded
ui.chat.attachments.broken_media_unavail.tone: plain statement, sentence case, full stops
ui.chat.attachments.broken_media_unavail.length: One sentence; it is the card's whole text, the tooltip and the accessible name, and truncates with an ellipsis on a narrow card.
ui.chat.attachments.broken_media_unavail.note: The same fact as `broken_unavailable` with the verb of a player ('played') instead of a picture's ('displayed'); keep the two sentences parallel. Same message for the visible text, tooltip and accessible name.

placeholders.name: the attachment's file name, shown verbatim and never translated; the code wraps it in a directional isolate
